### Brief Solutions

- **[id 120]**: Miguel uses 2 pads/week $\times$ 30 sheets/pad = 60 sheets/week. Over 4 weeks in a month: $60 \times 4 = 240$.
- **[id 121]**: Morisette brought 5 apples and 8 oranges. Kael brought $2 \times 5 = 10$ apples and $8 / 2 = 4$ oranges. Total fruits = $5 + 8 + 10 + 4 = 27$.
- **[id 122]**: Monday = 8 hrs. Tuesday & Wednesday = $8 - 2 = 6$ hrs each. Thursday through Sunday (4 days) = $6 + 1 = 7$ hrs each. Total = $8 + 6 + 6 + (4 \times 7) = 48$.
- **[id 123]**: Rosie runs $10 \text{ mph} \times 3 \text{ hrs} = 30\text{ miles}$, then $5 \text{ mph} \times 4 \text{ hrs} = 20\text{ miles}$. Total distance = $30 + 20 = 50$.
- **[id 124]**: Jennie stamps $\frac{1}{3} \times 60 = 20$ letters. If the pile now has 30, it started with $30 - 20 = 10$.
- **[id 125]**: Let the package have $P$ spoons. $P + 5 - 3 = 12 \implies P + 2 = 12 \implies P = 10$.
- **[id 126]**: Chicken sausages = 38. Fish sausages = $38 + 6 = 44$. Total = $38 + 44 = 82$.
- **[id 127]**: Lily made 50 friends; Amy made $50 + 20 = 70$. Total = $50 + 70 = 120$.
- **[id 128]**: Pepper = \$15. Watermelon = $3 \times 15 = \$45$. Orange = $45 - 5 = \$40$. Total = $(4 \times 45) + (20 \times 15) + (10 \times 40) = 180 + 300 + 400 = 880$.
- **[id 129]**: Total time = $500 \times 24\text{ mins} = 12{,}000\text{ mins} = 200\text{ hours}$. Net profit/hr = $\$200 - \$150 = \$50$. Total profit = $200 \times 50 = 10{,}000$.
